visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a spiky yellow and red wig, wearing a black and white uniform, leans against a wall while resting on a blue velvet ottoman. (2) A young girl with long black hair and a pink bow, wearing a black robe and a bamboo muzzle, holds a pink tablet decorated with various colorful stickers. She looks up toward the ceiling with wide eyes. (3) A woman in a floral white and green dress enters the frame, gesturing sternly with her hand toward the girl. The girl lowers the tablet and looks down. (4) The girl sits at a wooden table in an indoor living room setting, writing on a piece of paper with a white stylus while the woman stands over her with hands on her hips. (5) The man from the first phase wakes up suddenly, exhibiting an exaggerated wide-eyed and open-mouthed expression of surprise. He stands up and draws a wooden sword from its scabbard. (6) A digital transition with pink and yellow jagged patterns leads to a series of anime clips showing characters in high-motion combat. (7) Musicians on a stage with blue lighting are shown; a man plays a trombone, and women play violins in a professional orchestra setting. (8) A final graphic appears with text information about a concert, featuring various anime characters in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced orchestral BGM featuring high-pitched strings and a driving drum beat begins immediately. A muffled child's vocalization is heard under the music. (2) A sharp female voice enters with high intensity and authority, scolding someone to put away a tablet. The music continues as a consistent bed. (3) A percussive 'thud' sound occurs as a tablet is slammed down, followed by a metallic 'click' as a stylus is moved. (4) The female voice continues with a nagging, authoritative tone, while the BGM transitions into a more melodic anime-style vocal track. (5) A loud, exaggerated male shout triggers a new phase; the pitch is high and the tone is comedic. He speaks quickly with dramatic emphasis. (6) A 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a visual transition, leading into a loud, cinematic brass section featuring trombones and heavy percussion. (7) The final phase features a professional announcer-style male voice delivering promotional information with high arousal and excitement over a swelling orchestral finale.
